title: pvCosmoReader
body:
## pvCosmoReader

Reads binary cosmology particle files in LANL cosmo format (.cosmo, .cosmo64) or Gadget-2 format (vtkPCosmoReader) into an unstructured grid of particles with point arrays velocity, mass, tag and ghost. Several file names form a time series, one file per time step. Its output is the expected input of pvLANLFOFSODHaloFinder. Use pvGenericIOReader for HACC GenericIO output.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Set CosmoFormat to match the file; ParaView starts from Cosmo, and Gadget files read as cosmo give garbage.
- Particles outside [0, BoxSideLength) are wrapped periodically, so set the box size of the run.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CosmoReader`. Identity: `sources/CosmoReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BoxSideLength` | The box side length is used to wrap particles around if they exceed rL (or less than 0) in any dimension. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `CosmoFormat` | If checked, the data will be read as the LANL Cosmo format. If unchecked, the data will be read as Gadget-2 format. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Gadget","Cosmo"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Gadget"` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Overlap` | The space (in rL units) to extend processor particle ownership for ghost particles/cells. It is needed for correct halo calculation when halos cross processor boundaries in parallel computation. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCosmoReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
